query: WITH total_pop AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS total FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala WHERE snapshot = '2026-02-01' AND is_in_population = TRUE), over_60_pop AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS over_60 FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala WHERE snapshot = '2026-02-01' AND is_in_population = TRUE AND age > 60 AND age IS NOT NULL) SELECT (over_60 * 100.0 / total) AS percentage_over_60 FROM total_pop CROSS JOIN over_60_pop LIMIT 1200
raw_question: ما نسبة السكان في الفئة العمرية فوق 60 سنة في 2025؟
